name: sonarqube
description: Session-scoped SonarQube analysis: blocks a session from ending while files it touched still have secrets or Sonar findings, plus the official SonarQube MCP server. Requires the `sonar` CLI and Docker.

analysis_depth.title: Analysis depth
analysis_depth.description: Depth passed to `sonar analyze` as --depth. STANDARD is the CLI's normal pass. DEEP analyses more thoroughly and takes longer — the Stop hook runs under a 180s timeout, so prefer STANDARD on large changesets.

block_on.title: Block the session on
block_on.description: Which findings stop the session from ending. "secrets" runs only the local secrets scan, which sends no code anywhere and is fast. "secrets-and-issues" also runs a full `sonar analyze` and blocks on its findings too; if the server is unreachable, that stage is reported and skipped rather than blocking. Note that the CLI declines to run either stage until it has credentials — see the plugin README.
